g.text: Math & LaTeX Rendering Benchmark Suite (Font Size: 32px)
#1 Quadratic Formula — Unary minus (-b), binary ±, radical over b² - 4ac, and fraction bar on math axis
#2 Bracketed Radical Fraction — Smooth Bezier parentheses symmetric on math axis wrapping a tall surd & fraction
#3 Exponents on Tall Brackets — TeX Rule 18a sup_drop anchors exponents at top-right shoulder of tall ( ) and [ ]
#4 Curly Braces & Simultaneous Scripts — Extensible curly braces \{ \}, simultaneous sub/superscripts C_n^k, and compound exponents
#5 Distance Formula & Nested Surds — Subscripts and squared binomials inside a surd, plus nested square roots
#6 Difference Quotient & Continued Fraction — Balanced numerator/denominator clearances and nested fraction scaling
#7 Normal Density & Fractional Exponent — Greek letters (σ, μ, π) and bracketed fraction raised to a power inside an exponent
#8 Matrices & Exam Fill-in Boxes — 2x2 matrix with square brackets and interactive exam fill-in boxes/gaps
#9 Mixed Prose & Inline Math — Inline math alignment with surrounding Times New Roman prose baseline
If $a \neq 0$, roots of $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$ satisfy $x_1 + x_2 = -\frac{b}{a}$ and $x_1 x_2 = \frac{c}{a}$.
